# Chitin

Type: Material | Internal ID: Chitin | Source: Abyssal barnacle, ,, Coral cod | Usage: Crafting | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Chitin is a material found in the Ocean.
It is obtained by mining Abyssal barnacles found on Leviathans which appear as living, moving islands in the Ocean. Catching a Coral cod fish has a 13.33% of dropping 1-2 chitin, although catching them requires Heavy fishing bait (which can be difficult to obtain).

### Crafting

• Abyssal harpoon
• Abyssal razor
• Fins of Destiny
